parsed.why: Documented pattern of police raids on queer gatherings with beatings, forced medical exams, sexual harassment, blackmail and threats of outing; murder with inadequate investigation; no anti-discrimination law; virulent state-affiliated media. State-tolerated targeting, not mere societal disapproval.

No criminalisation and no documented state targeting or current violence; but no protections, dated/contested stigma, no trans framework. Thin record: resident gaps only, no visitor-facing exposure documented. Above de-facto-criminalising states, well below protective ones.

No express offence, yet public-morality provisions make same-sex conduct de facto illegal with unbounded scope; pervasive religious/social intolerance, no general non-discrimination remedy. Documented hostile climate with thin recourse; worse than non-criminalising thin-data states.

Explicit criminalisation enforced by courts issuing death sentences (stoning, crucifixion), flogging and imprisonment in 2024; law licensing vigilante violence; no state protection; breach-of-modesty laws reach expression. Near the extreme of do-not-visit.

Same-sex conduct decriminalised 2025; domestic-violence act expressly protects gender identity and trans victims, with police/port/customs sensitisation. No trans-specific violence data and dated anti-gay incidents keep it short of Low Risk.
